item.pick: Search for an item or fluid to see its recipes ({{recipes}} recipes loaded).
item.planHelp: Pick the recipe to make it with: “Plan with this” adds the item to the plan on that recipe.

plan.title: Plan
plan.noTargets: Search an item and pick the recipe to make it with.
plan.empty: Add a target to plan a production line: search an item on the left, open it and press “Plan with this” on the recipe to make it with.
plan.failed: The solver could not build a line ({{status}}).
plan.baseNote: Each recipe runs on its default machine at the max tier with the pack's exact overclock and chance boost, unless you set it up with “machine…”. Default multiblocks have one 2A energy hatch and no parallel hatch; blast furnaces the lowest coil that reaches the recipe's heat.
plan.banRecipe: Ban this recipe from the plan
plan.setupHint: Set up the machine for this recipe: hatches, parallel hatch, coil
plan.configErrorHint: Your machine setup cannot run this recipe; the default machine is used
plan.unreachable: {{names}}: no recipe chain at the max tier starts from the raw resources. Raise the max tier, buy an input raw, or switch to recipe mode.
plan.idle: Busy {{load}} of the time: it waits for its inputs the rest of the time. The line still balances, so nothing backs up; Optimize's full-time line can get closer to 100% by scaling the line up.

picker.title: Recipes for {{name}}
picker.help: “Use” makes the plan produce this item only with that recipe; “Ban” keeps a recipe out of the plan.
picker.unexpand: Don’t make it (use as an input)

setup.title: Machine setup
setup.cannotRun: No machine allowed by the plan can run this recipe.
setup.fallback: The plan uses the default machine for now.
setup.approximate: This machine has bonuses the planner does not model yet (threading, multi smelter, hellforge, …): it is at least this fast.

error.unknown_machine: This machine is not in the data.
error.wrong_machine: This machine cannot run this recipe.
error.insufficient_voltage: The energy hatches cannot reach the recipe's voltage.
error.coil_temperature_too_low: This coil is too cold for the recipe.

graph.help: Click a machine to set it up, an input or shared item to pick its recipe, an output to open the item. Orange arrows run in a loop.

mode.recipeHelp: You build the line into your factory: “recipe…” on an item expands it with the recipe you pick, “machine…” sets the machine and its tier. Items you do not expand come from your factory.

optimize.title: Optimize the line
optimize.help: Keeps what the line makes and the recipes you picked. Looks for machine voltages and coils that take less from the factory, leave fewer byproducts, need fewer machines and then less power, in that order. Coils are offered up to the one a tier below the max tier (HSS-G at IV). The line stays balanced: every item made inside is used as fast as it is made and every recipe has enough whole machines for what reaches it, so nothing backs up and nothing runs dry; a machine below 100% only waits for its next input.
optimize.noSetups: Every machine already runs at its best voltage and coil.
optimize.perfect: Every machine already works full time.
optimize.ratioHelp: Output rates nearest to yours at which the built machines spend more of their time working (with the setups above):
optimize.noAlternatives: No other recipe makes the line better.
optimize.batch: Whole crafts: feed {{amount}} {{name}} and every recipe with items runs a whole number of times
optimize.exactHelp: Whole machines that all work (nearly) the whole time: every item made inside the line is used up as fast as it is made and no machine waits. The search takes up to half a minute.
optimize.exactFound: Every machine works at least {{busy}} of the time at {{scale}}× your targets: {{machines}} machines, {{eu}} EU/t.
optimize.notProven: (best found in the time limit, a smaller one may exist)
optimize.exactNone: No line where every machine is busy {{busy}} of the time was found within 256 machines per recipe and {{s}} s.
optimize.exactLimit: {{name}} alone needs the line at least {{scale}}× bigger: even one machine on its slowest setup works faster than the line feeds it.
optimize.exactWarning: Experimental. This scales production up: durations are whole ticks and chances are fractions, so keeping every machine busy usually needs a line several times bigger than your targets (the PlatLine at 99% runs at about 25×). Each step of the slider down makes the line smaller.
